arbitration: One shared cash account and at most ONE open position total across permitted assets. Same-symbol RSI/compression conflicts abstain; RSI priority on agreement. Native quotes merged chronologically; Gold wins exact timestamp tie. No separate-account return summing.

guards.PROP_FUNDED: Per case: internal PEAK_8_DAILY_4 or numerical STATIC_9_DAILY_4_5. Both cap stop-risk admission by remaining room, close and permanently stop on failure. UTC reset, not certified exact firm calendar or terms.
guards.PERSONAL_STRESS: 10% daily,50% of original capital from peak. Deliberately broad research stress guards, not customer defaults. Requested risk can be reduced by margin, remaining loss room, minimum lot and lot-step.

leverage: Notional ceiling and entry margin; not a complete MT5 stop-out or crypto liquidation model.
selection: Retrospective reused May-November source; comparisons not independent validation. No claim of actual firm compliance.
costs: Gold commission5.25/lot/side, slip0.075/oz/side; JPY commission3.5/lot/side, slip0.001/side; observed bid/ask;3s entry,1s management;1.5bps notional/calendar-day adverse financing. No reset/forced close at month ends.
